description: This file contains the implementation of a JWT validator class ('DefaultJwtValidator') within a security authentication module for a gateway service. It handles JWT validation by retrieving public keys and verifying tokens.

classes.name: DefaultJwtValidator
classes.description: A thread-safe implementation of JwtValidator that validates JSON Web Tokens using a public key provider.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultJwtValidator with a specified public key provider.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a JSON Web Token asynchronously by retrieving the public key and verifying the token.

methods.name: tryToValidateWithPublicKey
methods.description: Attempts validation with a given public key, catching exceptions indicating failure.

methods.name: validateWithPublicKey
methods.description: Performs the actual JWT validation by parsing and verifying the token with the provided public key.
